edges.natural_language_summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Armenia functions as a subordinate body directly under the Ministry of Defense of Armenia. This structural relationship means that the MoD maintains ultimate oversight and command authority over the military's operational planning and strategic direction. This connection is vital as it establishes the official chain of command for national defense and security policy implementation.

evidence.title: www.gov.am
evidence.fact: Chief of General Staff of RA Armed Forces: Edvard Asryan

model_analysis.political_implication: The relationship confirms the Ministry of Defense's central and authoritative role in national security, ensuring that the operational command structure of the military (the General Staff) remains under direct civilian governmental control.
model_analysis.interpretation: This represents a standard, foundational hierarchical military structure, indicating clear lines of command and centralized state authority over the armed forces.

edges.human_text: General Staff → part of Ministry of Defense
edges.short_label: General Staff → part of Ministry of Defense
edges.semantic_summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces operates within the Ministry of Defense of Armenia.

edges.natural_language_summary: The Ministry of Defense is formally established as a core, integral component of the Government of Armenia. This structural relationship means the MoD operates under the legal and administrative authority of the central government. This connection is critical because it dictates the chain of command and ensures that national military policy is officially sanctioned by the executive branch.

model_analysis.political_implication: The relationship centralizes national security policy, meaning that the military's actions and strategic direction are subject to the oversight and ultimate authority of the executive branch (the Government).
model_analysis.interpretation: The MoD functions as a state arm of the government, confirming that its existence and operational mandate are constitutionally recognized and politically dependent on the central state apparatus.

edges.human_text: Ministry of Defense → part of Government
edges.short_label: Ministry of Defense → part of Government
edges.semantic_summary: The Ministry of Defense is a state body within the Government of Armenia.

edges.natural_language_summary: The Ministry of Internal Affairs (MIA) functions as a core, subordinate institution within the Government of Armenia. This structural relationship establishes the MIA as the primary state body responsible for enforcing domestic law, maintaining public order, and executing security policies. Its subordination ensures that the central government maintains direct operational control over the nation's law enforcement apparatus.

evidence.title: www.gov.am
evidence.fact: Ministry of Internal Affairs Minister: Arpine Sargsyan

model_analysis.political_implication: This relationship is fundamental to the state's coercive power. Any political instability or conflict involving the MIA directly threatens the government's ability to maintain internal order and enforce its policies, making it a critical indicator of regime stability.
model_analysis.interpretation: The MIA is an essential pillar of the state structure. Its formal subordination to the Government of Armenia confirms centralized control over security matters, making it a non-negotiable component of the state's operational capacity.

edges.human_text: Ministry of Internal Affairs → part of Government of Armenia
edges.short_label: Ministry of Internal Affairs → part of Government of Armenia
edges.semantic_summary: Ministry of Internal Affairs is a subordinate body of Government of Armenia.

edges.natural_language_summary: The office of the Minister of Internal Affairs is the executive leadership position that operates within the larger institutional framework of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. This relationship defines the operational hierarchy, as the office holder is the primary authority responsible for directing the ministry's functions. This structural connection is vital for the state's ability to maintain law and order and enforce internal security.

evidence.title: www.gov.am
evidence.fact: Ministry of Internal Affairs Minister: Arpine Sargsyan

model_analysis.political_implication: The office holder wields significant state power, making the position a critical political nexus. Changes in this office can signal major shifts in the government's security policy, law enforcement priorities, or political alignment.
model_analysis.interpretation: This represents a fundamental structural dependency, where the executive leadership (the office) is institutionally embedded within the state apparatus (the ministry), making the connection permanent and foundational to state governance.

edges.human_text: Minister of Internal Affairs → within Ministry of Internal Affairs
edges.short_label: Minister of Internal Affairs → within Ministry of Internal Affairs
edges.semantic_summary: The office of Minister of Internal Affairs is a position within Ministry of Internal Affairs.

edges.natural_language_summary: Arpine Sargsyan currently holds the ministerial position of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. This role places him at the core of national security, law enforcement, and domestic order within the government. His tenure in this ministry grants him substantial political and operational power, making him a key figure in the state's security apparatus.

evidence.title: www.gov.am
